proof: state-model representability only; no runtime or gateway consumer. Channel match on possession and Tier C replies cannot decide alone in v1, and neither can a channel without an authenticated ingress on a possession reply: the set of authenticated ingresses changes only across a restart, which invalidates every pending operation first. The WhatsApp steps are two-fault by construction. A channel without an authenticated ingress decides alone only on a Tier C reply after a restart that removed SMS ingress. Each scenario starts with SMS as its one authenticated ingress, device edge-1 and site site-1; a restart step's sms_ingress, device_id and site_id set the configuration it starts under, and a restart without one keeps that part unchanged. A change of either is a restart or an apply_provisioning step, which changes it while the runtime runs, as runtime-config-orchestration/v1 applies an accepted document whole.
